stories.title: Cotton and the Lost Star
stories.tagline: A little bunny helps a star find its way home
stories.description: One night, a little star fell into the meadow. Cotton the bunny gently helps it back up to the sky, and learns that a small kindness can light up the whole night.

stories.title: Little Bear Isn’t Sleepy
stories.tagline: Little Bear learns to relax and drift off to sleep
stories.description: It is late, but Little Bear Mun is still wide awake. With help from Grandpa Owl, the Fireflies and the stars, Mun learns to breathe slowly and sleep soundly.

stories.title: The Little Whale’s Lullaby
stories.tagline: Blue finds a new friend in the night sea
stories.description: Tonight, little whale Blue has to sing alone in the dark sea. Then Little Jelly appears, glowing like a lantern, and Blue’s song brings Mama home.

stories.title: Cloud the Kitten Looks for Sleep
stories.tagline: A kitten searches for her lost sleep
stories.description: Cloud the kitten has lost her sleep. She asks the Wind, she asks the Fireflies, and at last she finds her sleep somewhere very close.

stories.title: Duckling’s Moonlight Swim
stories.tagline: Little Yellow is no longer afraid of the dark
stories.description: Little Yellow is scared of the dark pond. With help from Sister Moon and the Little Fish, Little Yellow finds that the night is gentle too.

stories.title: Green Frog Counts the Stars
stories.tagline: Count to five with Green Frog, then sleep
stories.description: Green Frog sits on a lily pad and counts the stars. One, two, three, four, five… and before he knows it, his eyes are closing.

stories.title: Little Turtle Goes Home
stories.tagline: Little Turtle’s journey to the sea
stories.description: Little Turtle has just hatched on the sand. With the moonlight and Red Crab showing the way, Little Turtle bravely crawls home to the blue sea.

stories.title: Little Fox and the Lantern
stories.tagline: A lantern that lights up friendship
stories.description: Little Fox has a star-shaped lantern. Along the way, Little Fox uses its light to help friends in the forest find their way home.

stories.title: Little Elephant Wants to Sleep
stories.tagline: Little Elephant looks for a cozy place to sleep
stories.description: Little Elephant is so big that every bed feels too small. He tries a tree, a burrow and the lake shore, and finally finds the very best place to sleep.

stories.title: The Penguin Who Dreamed of Flying
stories.tagline: Little Penguin’s dream of flying
stories.description: Little Penguin wishes he could fly like the seagull. That night, in a dream, Little Penguin soars up into the glowing northern lights.

stories.title: Brown Squirrel Hides His Acorns
stories.tagline: Brown Squirrel learns to share
stories.description: Brown Squirrel hides lots of acorns to save for winter. But when a friend is hungry, Brown Squirrel does something very sweet.

stories.title: Little Hippo Brushes His Teeth
stories.tagline: A happy morning with a toothbrush
stories.description: Every morning, Little Hippo is too lazy to brush his teeth. Today, Sparrow shares a secret with him: brushing your teeth can be as fun as a song.

stories.title: Little Piglet Feels Better
stories.tagline: Learning to talk about feelings
stories.description: At noon, Little Piglet gets cross when her block tower falls down. With Panda’s help, she learns to take deep breaths and say how she feels.

stories.title: Puppy Looks for the Rainbow
stories.tagline: An afternoon after the rain
stories.description: One afternoon, the rain has just stopped. Puppy and Little Frog go looking for the end of the rainbow, and learn that a rainbow has seven beautiful colors.

stories.title: Fluff the Owl and the Cozy Leaf
stories.tagline: Two friends make a cozy nest
stories.description: Fluff the little owl wants a softer nest to sleep in. Brown Squirrel helps find a soft leaf, and together they settle down for a peaceful night.

stories.title: The Little Hedgehog Who Wanted a Hug
stories.tagline: Spiky finds the gentlest hug of all
stories.description: Spiky the little hedgehog feels sad because his prickles mean nobody can hug him. Mama Hedgehog shows him how to hug softly, and that night Spiky sleeps snug in her arms.

stories.title: Little Bear Tidies Up
stories.tagline: Toys go home, Little Bear goes to bed
stories.description: At bedtime, Honey Bear’s toys are scattered all over the room. Mr. Nightlight helps Honey Bear bring each toy home, and then the whole room drifts off to sleep.

stories.title: Otters Hold Hands to Sleep
stories.tagline: Hold on tight and nobody drifts away
stories.description: Little Otter is afraid to sleep on the sea in case the waves carry her away. Big Brother Otter shares a secret: hold hands tight and fall asleep together.

stories.title: Slow Little Snail
stories.tagline: Slow and steady, slow and happy
stories.description: Little Snail feels sad for being the slowest in the garden. On the way home one afternoon, Ladybug helps him see how many lovely things you notice when you go slow.

stories.title: The Little Firefly Lights Up
stories.tagline: Even a small light is precious
stories.description: Little Firefly is too shy to light up because her glow is so small. Tonight a baby bunny gets lost, and that small light is just what guides him home.

stories.title: Tabby’s Bubble Bath
stories.tagline: Clean and cozy, then off to bed
stories.description: Tabby the kitten played all day and got muddy from head to toe, but he doesn’t want a bath. Rubber Duck turns bath time into a fun bubble game.

stories.title: Koala Listens to the Rain
stories.tagline: The rain sings a gentle lullaby
stories.description: On a rainy night, Baby Koala wakes up to the pitter patter on the leaves. Mama Koala teaches him to listen, and the rain becomes the softest lullaby of all.

stories.title: The Giraffe Who Loved Her Neck
stories.tagline: What makes you different is lovely
stories.description: Little Giraffe feels shy about her very long neck. This afternoon, Monkey’s kite gets stuck at the top of a tree, and only Little Giraffe can reach it.

stories.title: Fluffy Lamb Meets the Clouds
stories.tagline: Sheep shaped clouds up in the sky
stories.description: Fluffy Lamb lies on a hill watching the clouds, and every cloud looks like a little sheep. Breeze carries the clouds off to bed, and Fluffy Lamb’s eyes grow sleepy too.

stories.title: Little Mouse and the Moon
stories.tagline: Why the Moon grows and shrinks
stories.description: Little Mouse sees the Moon change every night, sometimes round like a cake, sometimes curved like a smile. Wise Owl tells Little Mouse the Moon’s secret.

stories.title: Little Lion Learns to Whisper
stories.tagline: At night we use quiet voices
stories.description: Little Lion loves to roar very loudly, even while everyone is sleeping. Mama Lion teaches him to whisper so the whole forest can sleep well.

stories.title: Little Bee Makes Honey
stories.tagline: Working together is quicker
stories.description: Little Bee wants to make a whole jar of honey all by herself. But the sweetest honey comes when she makes it together with her friends.

stories.title: Polar Bear and the Northern Lights
stories.tagline: The sky dances with color
stories.description: In the land of ice and snow, Polar Bear Cub stays up late with Mama to watch the northern lights. Ribbons of green, pink and purple dance across the sky.

stories.title: Hermit Crab Finds a New Home
stories.tagline: Growing up means a new home
stories.description: Hermit Crab has grown, and the old shell is far too tight. Red Crab helps find a new shell that fits just right, and Hermit Crab learns that change isn’t so scary.

stories.title: Little Monkey’s Nap Time
stories.tagline: Nap now, play more later
stories.description: Little Monkey is too busy swinging on vines to take a nap. Grandma Elephant tells him why a nap makes the afternoon even more fun.

stories.title: Little Bat Sleeps All Day
stories.tagline: Everyone has their own sleepy time
stories.description: Little Bat wakes up when everyone else goes to bed, and goes to sleep when the sun comes up. Little Bat shows you the forest at night, then hangs upside down to sleep at dawn.

stories.title: Little Reindeer’s Christmas Eve
stories.tagline: A cozy, snowy Christmas night
stories.description: On Christmas Eve, Little Reindeer helps Grandma Bear trim the tree and hang a stocking by the fire, then spots a sleigh flying past the Moon before bedtime.

stories.title: Little Bear’s Thankful Dinner
stories.tagline: An autumn full of thank yous
stories.description: In autumn, Little Bear picks a pumpkin, bakes a pie with Mama, and sits down to a big family dinner where everyone shares what they are thankful for.

stories.title: Little Lamb’s Easter Egg Hunt
stories.tagline: A spring morning full of colorful eggs
stories.description: One spring morning, Little Lamb and Baby Chick hunt for painted eggs hidden all over the flower meadow. Little Lamb finds lots, and shares them with her friend.

stories.title: Raccoon’s Campfire Night
stories.tagline: A night by the campfire
stories.description: Little Raccoon goes camping by the lake with Daddy. They toast marshmallows for s’mores, look for the North Star, and fall asleep snug in their tent.
